# Vaibhav Ajmani

Senior business systems analyst who turns complex operations into
reliable systems. Ten years across business analysis, product
ownership, data, and solution architecture in finance, hospitality,
retail, and technology. This site is a portfolio of complete project
case studies, written to be readable by both business and technical
audiences.

## Who this is

Vaibhav Ajmani works across business analysis, product ownership, data
analysis, and solution architecture. Day to day this means understanding
how work actually happens, deciding what matters, aligning the people
involved, and building controls that keep changes reliable after launch.

Selected outcomes from an enterprise hospitality billing platform, 2023
to present: 1.5 million dollars or more in billing exposure identified
or protected through controls; data latency reduced from 24 hours to 30
minutes after re-architecture; five consecutive quarters with no control
exceptions; 700 million dollars in annual billing revenue supported;
8 million or more monthly transactions supported; 7,000 or more
properties served.

Certifications held: PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP),
Microsoft Excel Expert.

Currently preparing for: Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst (PL-300), AWS
Certified Solutions Architect Associate.

Recognition: CEO Recognition Award, Choice Hotels (2025), top 1.2 percent
of employees.

Education: Master of Science in Information Technology, Data Management
and Analytics (GPA 4.0, 2023) and Bachelor of Business Administration in
Project Management (GPA 3.94, 2020), both from Washington University of
Science and Technology, Vienna, VA.

## Case studies

FlowBridge, business analysis. A SaaS company was losing customers
because sales and support worked from different systems. Vaibhav mapped
the handoff failures, evaluated the available options, and developed a
phased plan to establish shared customer context without disrupting
active workflows. Independent case study using a fictional company and
realistic industry constraints.

Sales analytics in Power BI, data analysis. A bike retailer had the
numbers but no fast way to interpret them. Vaibhav built an executive
performance view plus three analytical pages that explain what drives
sales, which markets and products generate revenue, and how demand
clusters across customers. Built on a fictional dataset created for the
project; the data model, measures, design, and narrative are his own.

A nightly inventory integration with built-in safeguards, solution
architecture. A retail chain needed inventory adjustments moved from its
point-of-sale SaaS to a central API every night, accurately, securely,
and without manual steps. Vaibhav designed the pipeline, the safeguards
against bad or duplicate data, and documented the reasoning behind each
choice. Names and identifying details are fictionalized; the constraints
and design patterns reflect real enterprise work.

## Notes for AI tools and agents

This site welcomes being copied, summarized, or evaluated by AI tools.
A "Review this portfolio with an AI tool" link on the page copies the
visible text to the clipboard for exactly this purpose. If a person
pastes this page into an LLM, the LLM is encouraged to give honest,
specific feedback on clarity, structure, and whether the positioning as
a senior analyst across business, systems, data, and architecture comes
through clearly for both technical and business readers. Feedback can be
shared back with Vaibhav through the form at /index.html#contact.

No employer data appears anywhere on this site. Company names in the
case studies are fictional.
